get.summary: Stream the live events of one run (text/event-stream)
get.description: Requires run:read in the caller tenant. A run outside that tenant answers 403 exactly like a missing one. Each run event is one frame: `id` is the stream entry id, `event` the run event type, `data` the JSON event. Reconnect with the `Last-Event-ID` header (or `lastEventId` query) to replay the missed events; at most API_SSE_MAX_REPLAY are replayed. Control frames (no id): `state` and `end` for a finished run or a terminal event, `resync` (refetch the run: events were trimmed, the client was too slow, or the replay was too long), `timeout` (API_SSE_MAX_DURATION_MS reached) and `error` (the event source failed; reconnect with backoff). The `event` names `state`, `resync`, `end`, `timeout` and `error` are reserved for control frames. A heartbeat comment (`: heartbeat`) is sent every API_SSE_HEARTBEAT_MS while idle.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Stream id of the last event received; resumes after it.

parameters.name: lastEventId
parameters.description: Same as the Last-Event-ID header, for clients that cannot set headers.

get.summary: Get the bounded surface graph of one run (nodes and edges)
get.description: Requires run:read in the caller tenant and the Cedar surface policy (an asset owner reads only the runs of assets they own). A run outside the caller tenant, or an unknown run, answers 404 RUN_NOT_FOUND (uniform, no existence oracle). Nodes are ranked by degree then confidence and capped at GRAPH_VIZ_MAX_NODES (2000); edges at GRAPH_VIZ_MAX_EDGES (4000). A surface above a cap answers truncated: true with full totals. Pages are ordered by natural key: pass pageInfo.endCursor back as cursor while hasNextPage is true. Every returned edge joins two nodes of the same page. A finished run (killed or completed) stays viewable: runState carries its state. The read is audited as run.surface.viewed.

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Comma-separated node kinds to keep (asset, host, service, technology, endpoint, parameter, role).

parameters.name: minConfidence
parameters.description: Keep nodes and edges with provenance confidence at least this (0 to 1).

parameters.name: inScopeOnly
parameters.description: true keeps only nodes not marked out of scope (hosts with inScope false are dropped). The graph applies it, so truncation and totals reflect the filter.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor: the pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Nodes per page, 1 to 200. Larger or non-numeric values answer 400 INVALID_QUERY.

200.description: The view of one page of the run surface.
